Definition: Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings
BiblicalUsage: Jabin = "whom God observes"; 1) a king of Hazor who organised a confederacy of the northern princes against Joshua; confederacy routed by the waters of Merom; 2) another king of Hazor whose general, Sisera, was defeated by Barak
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
